title: New Sgt. Frog TV Anime Reveals October 3 Debut, Main Cast in Video
content: Bandai Namco Pictures revealed the first main promotional video on Monday for Keroro Gunsō ☆ , an all-new Sgt. Frog television anime . The video reveals the show's new cast, full staff, and October 3 debut. The anime will feature an all-new cast for the franchise.
author: ANN

title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom Anime Reveals More Cast Members, Opening Song in 2nd Trailer
content: The official website for the television anime of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Ōkoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga revealed the anime's second trailer and additional cast members on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 'Keroro Gunsou☆' Reveals Main Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for a new television anime adaptation of Mine Yoshizaki 's Keroro Gunsou ( Sgt. Frog ) manga revealed the main cast, staff, a key visual (pictured right), and the first promotional video on Monday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 3 at 9:30 a.m. on TV Tokyo.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Dark Machine the Animation Series Reveals 3 New Cast Members, October 13 Debut
content: The staff for Dark Machine the Animation , the original anime for the Dark Machine game and anime project , revealed on Monday three additional cast members and the anime's October 13 debut. The new cast members all play members of team Stellatus, a rival team of Kairi's Carbuncle team, and also work as an idol unit.
author: ANN

title: 'Dark Machine: The Animation' Announces Supporting Cast
content: The official website for the Dark Machine: The Animation television anime announced the supporting cast on Monday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 14 at 1:45 a.m. on Fuji TV, followed by Kansai TV and BS Fuji.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Uncle's Obsession with Cute Things Anime's 2nd Trailer Reveals More Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content: The official website for the television anime of Tsutomu 's Ojisan wa Kawaii Mono ga Osuki. (Older Men Like Cute Things) manga started streaming the anime's second promotional video, and revealed four new cast members, and the theme song artists on Monday.
author: ANN

title: 'Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi' Reveals Additional Cast, Opening Theme, Second Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nao Iwamoto 's Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi ( The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom ) manga revealed the additional cast, opening theme, and the second promotional video on Monday.

title: Actor, Voice Actor Toru Shinagawa Dies at 90
content: Knockout stated Shinagawa had been undergoing medical treatment for lymphoma. Shinagawa was born in Hokkaido in 1935, and graduated from a performing arts institute in 1962. After graduation he joined a theater troupe run by Takeo Hodoshima. Shinagawa was active in stage, film, television, and in voice acting.
author: ANN

title: Hunter x Hunter Manga Announces Hiatus, 4th Stage Play Featuring 'Chimera Ant Arc'
content: This year's 41st issue of Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine announced on Monday that Yoshihiro Togashi 's Hunter X Hunter manga will go on hiatus, and will announce its return at a later date. In addition, a new stage play titled Hunter X Hunter The Stage 4 was announced.
author: ANN

title: Hindi Dub of Ragna Crimson Anime Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
